title: Holiday and Cruise
blurb: Buffets, sunburn, souvenir shopping and who misses the boat.

questions.text: Who would be most likely to get sunburnt on the first day and stay red all week?
Who is most likely to eat seven dinners at the buffet?
Who would be most likely to join every activity on the cruise ship schedule?
Who would get lost on a ship the size of a small town?
Who among us is most likely to miss the boat while shopping for souvenirs?
Who would be most likely to befriend the entire pool bar staff by day two?
Who do you reckon is most likely to grab a deckchair at 5am with a towel and a plan?
Who's the one most likely to book an excursion and sleep through it?
Who would be most likely to haggle at a market and still overpay?
Who is most likely to pack six outfits per day and wear one?
Who would be most likely to lose their passport at the airport and find it in their own pocket?
Who would get seasick on a calm day?
Who among us is most likely to win the ship's trivia night and brag for a month?
Who would be most likely to enter the talent show and be genuinely good?
Who do you reckon is most likely to make friends with a stranger and end up in their holiday photos?
Who's the one most likely to spend the whole holiday reading one book and not finish it?
Who would be most likely to wear a lanyard and a hat with a tiny fan on it?
Who is most likely to photograph every meal and post none of it?
Who would be most likely to say "I'm not hungry" and eat the entire dessert table?
Who would try the local street food and regret it?
Who among us is most likely to cry at the sail-away party?
Who would be most likely to get a fridge magnet from every port?
Who do you reckon is most likely to forget their sunscreen and borrow a stranger's?
Who's the one most likely to leave a towel on a sunbed and come back to find it gone?
Who would be most likely to book a hotel with a "partial sea view" that's mostly a car park?
Who is most likely to wave at every passing boat?
Who would be most likely to fall asleep on a deckchair and wake up with a sunburnt sock line?
Who would cause a minor international incident at customs?
Who among us is most likely to get a group photo taken at every possible landmark?
Who would be most likely to need three hours to check in at the airport?
Who do you reckon is most likely to stay at the resort the whole time and never see the town?
Who's the one most likely to jump off something high on a dare?
Who would be most likely to learn four words of the local language and use them for everything?
Who is most likely to ask the captain for a tour of the bridge?
Who would be most likely to wear a Hawaiian shirt and call it formal?
Who would fall in love with a place and talk about moving there?
Who among us is most likely to order the wrong thing in a restaurant and eat it anyway?
Who would be most likely to snore so loudly the cabin next door complains?
Who do you reckon is most likely to stay up all night to watch the sunrise and sleep through it?
Who's the one most likely to have a holiday fling and cry at the airport?
Who would be most likely to swap numbers with someone at the pool bar?
Who is most likely to get a sunburn in a very awkward place?
Who would be most likely to skinny-dip and leave their clothes behind?
